messages.subject: Error deploying app to ShinyApps
parts:
Hello, 

We are having an issue when deploying our apps to ShinyApps, there is an error that says "Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 258143974 error: Unhandled Exception: Repository must be specified for Bioconductor package source"

I looked at these two posts (https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/shinyapps-users/Z4FdXRtk42k) (https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/shinyapps-users/TODqX73kMxk), the first of which the problem seems to be very similar, but I tried what was suggested in both and it did not work for us. Mostly, it seems like the error is coming from the "cellrangerRkit" package, as this is really the only package we are using so far besides more standard ones.
